newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Banking raises FRCD to US$75 mln.
newsitem.headline: China Banking raises FRCD to US$75 mln.

text.p: China Banking Corp's floating rate certificate of deposit issue was increased to US$75 million from US$60 million due to oversubscription, arranger Standard Chartered Bank said Tuesday.
The facility has a final maturity of three years. The issue was priced at par to float at 85 basis points over the three-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 91 basis points.
Arrangers and lead managers with US$5 million each, are Development Bank of Singapore, LTCB Asia, Standard Chartered Bank and AFC Merchant Bank.
Co-arrangers and lead managers, with US$4 milllion each, are Dresdner SEA and Sakura Finance Asia.
Co-lead managers, with US$4 million each, are Bank of Taiwan Singapore, Hua Nan Commercial Bank Singapore, International Commercial Bank of China Offshore Banking Branch and OCBC.

Senior managers, with US$3 million each, are Baden-Wurttembergische Bank, Bank Austria Aktiengesellschaft, Singapore, Bank Sinopac, Berliner Bank Aktiengesellschaft, Comerica Bank, First Commercial Bank Singapore and Tat Lee Bank.

Other senior managers, with US$2 million each, are Bankers Trust Hong Kong, Far Eastern International Offshore Banking Branch, ING Barings, Taiwan Cooperative Bank Offshore Banking Branch and Thai Farmers Bank PCL.
